# d2afbb1 literal defaults and viewer rows; do not regenerate from the shared table.
[actions]
NextTab	Control+Tab
PreviousTab	Control+Shift+Tab
Focus(Left)	Option+H
Focus(Right)	Option+L
Focus(Up)	Option+K
Focus(Down)	Option+J
FocusTabPosition	Option+1…9 / Option+0
ShowWorkspacePosition	Option+Shift+1…9 / Option+Shift+0
NextAttention	Option+G
PreviousAttention	Option+Shift+G
ToggleInbox	Option+Q
CycleFocus	F6
ReturnToTerminal	Escape
TraverseChrome(Left)	Left
TraverseChrome(Right)	Right
TraverseChrome(Up)	Up
TraverseChrome(Down)	Down
CreatePane	Option+M
CreateColumn	Control+Option+M
CreateTab	Option+Shift+T
CloseTab	Option+Shift+W
ClosePane	Option+W
ToggleZoom	Option+Shift+Z
Move(Left)	Control+Option+Shift+H
Move(Right)	Control+Option+Shift+L
MovePaneSideways(Left)	Control+Option+H
MovePaneSideways(Right)	Control+Option+L
Move(Up)	Control+Option+K
Move(Down)	Control+Option+J
NewWindow	Option+Shift+N
Detach	Option+Shift+D
Quit	Option+Shift+Q or Command+Q
ToggleViewer	Option+/
ToggleHints	Option+Shift+B
ToggleSidebar	Option+Shift+H
Copy	Command+C
Paste	Command+V or Paste
OpenLink	Command+click
[viewer]
[Navigate]
Control+Tab	Focus next tab
Control+Shift+Tab	Focus previous tab
Option+H	Focus left column or previous tab
Option+L	Focus right column or next tab
Option+K	Focus pane above
Option+J	Focus pane below
Option+1…9 / Option+0	Focus tab by position
Option+Shift+1…9 / Option+Shift+0	Show session by position
Option+G	Jump to the next agent needing attention
Option+Shift+G	Jump to the previous agent needing attention
Option+Q	Show the attention inbox
F6	Cycle terminal, agent sidebar, tabs, and panes
Escape	Return focus to the terminal
Left / Right	Previous or next column or tab while tabs are focused
Up / Down	Previous or next pane or agent row while one is focused
[Tabs and panes]
Option+M	Create pane
Control+Option+M	Create column
Option+Shift+T	Create tab
Option+Shift+W	Close active tab
Option+W	Close selected pane
Option+Shift+Z	Zoom selected pane or restore columns
Control+Option+Shift+H	Move tab left
Control+Option+Shift+L	Move tab right
Control+Option+H	Move pane to left column
Control+Option+L	Move pane to right column
Control+Option+K	Move pane up
Control+Option+J	Move pane down
[Host]
Option+Shift+N	Open new Eon window
Option+Shift+D	Detach: hide the window, keep terminals running
Option+Shift+Q or Command+Q	Quit: close the window, stop its terminals
Option+/	Show or close shortcuts
Option+Shift+B	Show or hide shortcut hints
Option+Shift+H	Show or hide the agent sidebar
Command+C	Copy selected text or focused link
Command+V or Paste	Paste
Command+click	Open link
